info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Projects API

API for Coveo Platform

Contact Support:

item.name: Add a Single Resource to a Project.

request.description:
Add a single resource to a project.
**Required privileges:**` Projects - Edit` and `Resource types - View`

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"PROJECTS","type":"EDIT","targetId":"*"} ```

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

item.name: Get All Resource Ids of Specified Type Within a Project.

request.description:
Get all resource ids of specified type within a project.
**Required privileges:**` Projects - View` and `{resourceType} - View`

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"PROJECTS","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

query.description:
The text to filter resources by (applied to the resource id and name properties).
**Example:** `My Web source`

The 0-based number of the results page to fetch.
**Default:** `0`

The number of results to fetch per page.
**Default:** `50`

**Example:** `Project123`
